Landlord Move-In Inspection Pack
Galaxy Forge Implementation Kit v1.0 (September 2026)

FILES
- landlord_movein_inspection_pack_guide.pdf : main implementation guide
- landlord_movein_inspection_pack_workbook.xlsx : Excel workbook (4 sheets)
- movein_condition_report_form.docx : editable template
- photo_inventory_log.docx : editable template
- tenant_acknowledgment_packet.docx : editable template

HOW TO USE: start with Quick Start (section 2 of the guide), then work the 14-day plan in section 9.
SUPPORT: email support for file/usage questions within 7 days of purchase.
